scope: Bibliographic historical eligibility of frozen NLTK corpus documents only; no corpus additions, source-text searching, K4/crib access, scoring, or scorer/code changes.

cutoff.meaning: The English work or known English translation must historically predate 1990. This is not a certification that all bytes of the modern digital transcription existed before 1990.

eligibility_policy.include: Original-English classic or specifically identified historical English translation with dated library/primary/official evidence; exact modern transcription edition may remain unknown if disclosed.
eligibility_policy.exclude: Post-cutoff speeches; unknown historical work date; unidentified or modern translation.
eligibility_policy.nltk_bracket_years: Metadata only. Never automatically treated as first-publication dates or exact transcription-edition dates.
eligibility_policy.inaugural: 51 filename years <=1989 admitted using official historical collection-span and endpoint evidence; nine filename years >=1993 excluded. Collection-level corroboration, not 51 individual transcription audits.

limitations: Historical work/translation eligibility only; an exact pre-1990 text/transcription audit is not claimed.
Bibliographic sources do not prove the exact NLTK edition, punctuation, spelling, front matter, compilation boundaries, or subsequent digital corrections.
Blake is identified by author and generic NLTK collection title; historical English collections are dated, but the exact NLTK selection/compilation has not been matched.
Some catalog evidence was accessible only through search-index extraction; each such source is explicitly labeled, and direct-fetch failures were not bypassed.
No newly fetched literary or speech text is added to the corpus. Saved evidence is selected bibliographic metadata, excerpts, URLs, assertions and hashes.
